summary: Steel lookout on Cowee Bald in Nantahala National Forest, Jackson County, NC; sources disagree on build year and height, not regularly staffed since the 1960s, top cab normally locked.

facts.design: Steel tower with a live-in cab with catwalk; the Register gives 40 feet and a 14-by-14-foot cab, while BusyHiker and a photo album say 30 feet

staffing.status: not staffed on a regular basis since the 1960s (Register); emergency use shared with the NC Forest Service; no staffing at a September 2020 visit

access.note: Reached over gated FR 70; gates can be locked in winter; top cab normally locked; no signage noticed at the tower in a 2020 visit report

visit.trail_note: Drive FR 70 from Franklin to the turnaround before the gate, then walk the gravel road about half a mile; BusyHiker calls the views from the stairs limited in one passage and decent in another, and the top cab is normally locked

events.note: BusyHiker says built in 1933; the Register and the photo album say 1936
Register: 40-foot steel tower built 1936; photo album: 30-foot tower built by CCC Company 3445 of the F-20 camp
Register: not staffed on a regular basis since the 1960s; 1960 is an approximate year. The photo album says fire detection continued until the mid-1990s
Register: the tower was rebuilt in 1980
Registered December 30, 1993 as US 71, NC 3; nominated by Joe Nicholson, Wayah R.D.
Visit report dated September 4, 2020: tower and access road in excellent condition; no signage on the tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and the photo album say 1936; BusyHiker says 1933. No primary record was found, so the year is left disputed.
The Register gives a 40-foot tower; BusyHiker and the photo album say 30 feet. Not resolved, so no height_m is recorded.
The Register says the tower has not been staffed regularly since the 1960s; the photo album says it was used for fire detection until the mid-1990s. Not resolved.
The Register gives 4,892 ft for the lookout site and matches the record's 1,491.1 m. BusyHiker and the photo album give 4,944 ft for the peak; the difference is unexplained.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1933 or 1936) and height (30 or 40 ft) are disputed; the story reports both. The record's NGS None is consistent with the Register's registry numbers, which list no NGS entry. tnlandforms.us lists Cowee Bald (NCT045) with a code FB3563; it is not explained on the page, so it is not used. The Carolina Mountain Club page returned 404 and the MyHikes page repeats BusyHiker, so neither is cited. Current access rests on BusyHiker and a September 2020 visit report; no 2025 or 2026 source was found. The Register lists a September 2020 photo credited to Christopher Armenti, but the page gives no image URL, so no photo entry is recorded. The 'late 1960s' and 1960 staffing dates are approximate.
